# ai-product-manager

> An agent skill that gives anyone the judgment of a senior AI product manager and agent architect, so enterprise LLM, RAG and agent projects survive past the demo.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a concise, machine-readable map
of the project for large language models and AI agents.

## About

- Repository: https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill
- Primary content: Markdown agent skill (SKILL.md + references + templates); Node.js validation script
- License: MIT

## Key documents

- [README](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/blob/main/README.md): overview, installation, usage
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/blob/main/skills/ai-product-manager/SKILL.md): the skill entry point (principles, workflow, router, diagnostics)
- [references/](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/tree/main/skills/ai-product-manager/references): discovery, solution selection, agent architecture, tool design, building on Claude, scoping, ontology, POC, evaluation, lifecycle, production, risk, cases, pitfalls, evidence
- [templates/](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/tree/main/skills/ai-product-manager/templates): charter, discovery report, PRD, POC plan, eval plan, UAT plan, launch gate, runbook, ADR, allow-list, health check, continue/shrink/stop memo, agent design spec, tool spec
- [evals/](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/tree/main/evals): benchmark prompts, assertions and results
- [examples/](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/tree/main/examples): full sample answers produced with the skill
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/ChanMeng666/ai-product-manager-skill/blob/main/AGENTS.md): how AI agents should work in this repo

## For agents

To use the skill: install `skills/ai-product-manager/` into your skills directory (or via the Claude
Code plugin marketplace), then read SKILL.md and follow its router to the relevant reference.
To change the skill: read AGENTS.md and run `node scripts/validate.mjs`.
